notes.title: Last Night Shift update notes - January 1, 2024
notes.notes:
Latest update for Last Night Shift brings a variety of new bug fixes and improvements to the game.

Update Version 1.3.1

✅Return to office bug fix
✅Not requiring multiple fuses bug fix
✅Items are hidden in vent bug fix
✅Can start the car without refuelling gas bug fix
✅Improved level transitions
✅Faster AI
✅Small graphic changes
